reason: I am not putting my clients' receipts and bank screenshots into an unknown Telegram bot when I cannot tell who runs it or where the data is processed under UU PDP. And even if I did, without invoice number, PPN and NPWP fields or an export to Jurnal or Accurate, my staff would still retype everything.
objection: Client confidentiality. Who reads these documents, where are they stored and processed, and what do I tell a client if their data leaks through a bot I added to their group?
would_change_my_mind: A clear data processing agreement that complies with UU PDP, plus PPN, NPWP and invoice number fields and a direct import file for Accurate or Jurnal, proven on one of my real clients' month of nota.
